value.en: Now brothers contend for the state—if not the elder then the younger; though one dies he still wins prestige, and sons and grandsons will long lead the various states.
value.literal: Now brothers contend for the state—if not the elder brother then the younger; though one dies he still has a prestigious name, and sons and grandsons constantly lead the various states.

value.zh: 漢雖強，猶不能兼併匈奴。
value.en: Though Han is strong, it still cannot annex the Xiongnu.
value.literal: Though Han is strong, it still cannot annex and merge the Xiongnu.

value.zh: 奈何亂先古之制，臣事於漢，卑辱先單于，為諸國所笑！
value.en: How can we overturn ancient institutions, serve Han as subjects, humiliate the former Chanyu, and become a laughingstock to the various states!
value.literal: How can we disorder the institutions of former antiquity, serve Han as subjects, and humiliate the former Chanyu, becoming what the various states laugh at!

value.zh: 雖如是而安，何以復長百蠻！」
value.en: Even if we were secure thus, how could we again lead the hundred barbarians!"
value.literal: Even if we were secure thus, how could we again lead the hundred barbarians!"

value.zh: 左伊秩訾曰：「不然，強弱有時。
value.en: The Left Yizhi Zhi said, "It is not so—strength and weakness have their seasons.
value.literal: The Left Yizhi Zhi said: "It is not so—strength and weakness have their seasons.

value.zh: 今漢方盛，烏孫城郭諸國皆為臣妾。
value.en: Now Han is flourishing; the walled states of Wusun and all the rest have become Han subjects.
value.literal: Now Han is flourishing; the walled states of Wusun and all the rest have become subjects and concubines.

value.zh: 自且鞮侯單于以來，匈奴日削，不能取復，雖屈強於此，未嘗一日安也。
value.en: Since Chanyu Qiedihou, the Xiongnu have daily dwindled and could not recover; though they bent their strength here, they never had a day of peace.
value.literal: From the time of Chanyu Qiedihou onward, the Xiongnu daily dwindled and could not recover; though they bent their strength here, they never had a single day of peace.

value.zh: 今事漢則安存，不事則危亡，計何以過此！」
value.en: Now to serve Han is security; not to serve is extinction—what plan surpasses this!"
value.literal: Now to serve Han is security and survival; not to serve is peril and extinction—what plan surpasses this!"

value.zh: 諸大人相難久之，呼韓邪從其計，引眾南近塞，遣子右賢王銖婁渠堂入侍。
value.en: The great men disputed for a long time; Huhanye followed his plan, led his people south near the border, and sent his son the Right Wise King Zhu Louqu Tang to attend court.
value.literal: The various great men disputed one another for a long time; Huhanye followed his plan, led his masses south near the passes, and sent his son the Right Wise King Zhu Louqu Tang to enter and attend court.

value.zh: 郅支單于亦遣子右大將駒于利受入侍。
value.en: Chanyu Zhizhi also sent his son the Right Grand General Juyu Lishou to attend court.
value.literal: Chanyu Zhizhi also sent his son the Right Grand General Juyu Lishou to enter and attend court.

value.zh: 二月，丁巳，樂成敬侯許延壽薨。
value.en: In the second month, on day dingsi, Marquis Jing of Lecheng Xu Yanshou died.
value.literal: In the second month, on day dingsi, Marquis Jing of Lecheng Xu Yanshou died.

value.zh: 夏，四月，黃龍見新豐。
value.en: In summer, the fourth month, a yellow dragon appeared at Xinfeng.
value.literal: In summer, the fourth month, a yellow dragon appeared at Xinfeng.

value.zh: 丙申，太上皇廟火；
value.en: On day bingshen, the Grand Supreme Emperor's temple caught fire;
value.literal: On day bingshen, the Grand Supreme Emperor's temple caught fire;

value.zh: 甲辰，孝文廟火；
value.en: on day jiachen, Emperor Wen's temple caught fire;
value.literal: on day jiachen, Emperor Wen's temple caught fire;

value.zh: 上素服五日。
value.en: the emperor wore plain mourning garments for five days.
value.literal: the emperor wore plain white garments for five days.

value.zh: 烏孫狂王復尚楚主解憂，生一男鴟靡，不與主和，又暴惡失眾。
value.en: The Mad King of Wusun again married the Chu princess Jieyou and begot a son, Nimi; he was not harmonious with her and was violent and wicked, losing popular support.
value.literal: The Mad King of Wusun again took in marriage the Chu princess Jieyou and begot a son, Nimi; he was not harmonious with the princess and again was violent and wicked, losing the masses.

value.zh: 漢使衛司馬魏和意、副侯任昌至烏孫。
value.en: Han sent Guard Major Wei Heyi and Deputy Marquis Ren Chang to Wusun.
value.literal: Han sent Guard Major Wei Heyi and Deputy Marquis Ren Chang to Wusun.

value.zh: 公主言：「狂王為烏孫所患苦，易誅也。」
value.en: The princess said, "The Mad King is what Wusun suffers from; he is easy to kill."
value.literal: The princess said: "The Mad King is what Wusun suffers from; he is easy to execute."

value.zh: 遂謀置酒，使士拔劍擊之。
value.en: They plotted a banquet and had soldiers draw swords and strike him.
value.literal: They thereupon plotted to set out wine and had soldiers draw swords and strike him.

value.zh: 劍旁下，狂王傷，上馬馳去。
value.en: The sword struck beside him; the Mad King was wounded, mounted his horse, and fled.
value.literal: The sword struck beside him; the Mad King was wounded, mounted his horse, and galloped away.

value.zh: 其子細沈瘦會兵圍和意、昌及公主於赤谷城。
value.en: His son Xishen Sou gathered troops and besieged Heyi, Chang, and the princess at Red Valley City.
value.literal: His son Xishen Sou gathered troops and besieged Heyi, Chang, and the princess at Red Valley City.

value.zh: 數月，都護鄭吉發諸國兵救之，乃解去。
value.en: Several months later, Protector-General Zheng Ji mobilized troops from the various states to rescue them, and the siege was lifted.
value.literal: Several months later, Protector-General Zheng Ji mobilized the various states' troops to rescue them, and the siege was then lifted.

value.zh: 漢遣中郎將張遵持醫藥治狂王，賜金帛。
value.en: Han sent Palace Gentleman Zhang Zun with medicine to treat the Mad King and bestowed gold and silks.
value.literal: Han sent Palace Gentleman Zhang Zun bearing medicine to treat the Mad King and bestowed gold and silks.

value.zh: 因收和意、昌系瑣，從尉犁檻車至長安，斬之。
value.en: Thereupon Heyi and Chang were seized in fetters, sent in a caged cart from Weili to Chang'an, and beheaded.
value.literal: Thereupon Heyi and Chang were seized in fetters, sent in a caged cart from Weili to Chang'an, and beheaded.

value.zh: :班固贊曰：孝宣之治，信賞必罰，綜核名實。
value.en: Ban Gu's praise says: The governance of Emperor Xiaoxuan—rewards and punishments were sure, names and realities were comprehensively verified.
value.literal: Ban Gu's praise says: The governance of Emperor Xiaoxuan—rewards and punishments were sure, names and realities were comprehensively verified.

value.zh: 政事、文學、法理之士，鹹精其能。
value.en: Men of government affairs, letters, and legal principle all refined their abilities.
value.literal: Men of government affairs, letters, and legal principle all refined their abilities.

value.zh: 至於技巧、工匠、器械，自元、成間鮮能及之。
value.en: As for skill, craftsmen, and instruments—from the Yuan and Cheng reigns few could match it.
value.literal: As for skill, craftsmen, and instruments—from the Yuan and Cheng reigns few could match it.

value.zh: 亦足以知吏稱其職，民安其業也。
value.en: This too is enough to know that officials claimed their posts and the people were secure in their livelihoods.
value.literal: This too is enough to know that officials claimed their posts and the people were secure in their livelihoods.
